mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_no,b.prj_id,b.bill_stg_id,b.bill_odr_no,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt, b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt,b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.amnd_yn, b.orgnl_bill_id,b.rcpt_plan_dt,b.rmrk_desc,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id
mapper.select: WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF b
ORDER BY b.bill_id
SELECT p.prj_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{prefix},0))::text
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(substring(b.bill_no FROM '[0-9]+$')::bigint),0)+1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_no LIKE #{prefix} || '%' AND b.bill_no ~ '^B-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+$'
SELECT m.cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls m WHERE m.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY m.cls_ym

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.rcpt_amt) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id}),0)::bigint AS received, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.sply_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0)::bigint AS amendment_supply, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.tot_amt) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'),0)::bigint AS amendment_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id}) AS receipt_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill.bill a WHERE a.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND a.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM') AS amendment_count
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.bill SET bill_stts_cd=#{after},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor}, cnfrm_user_id=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} ELSE cnfrm_user_id END, cnfrm_at=CASE WHEN #{after}='CONFIRM' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE cnfrm_at END WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND bill_stts_cd=#{before}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO bill.bill(bill_no,prj_id,bill_stg_id,bill_odr_no,atrb_ym,bill_dt,sply_amt,vat_amt, bill_stts_cd,txinv_no,txinv_dt,amnd_yn,orgnl_bill_id,rcpt_plan_dt,rmrk_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{number},#{original.prj_id},NULL,#{original.bill_odr_no},#{original.atrb_ym}, #{input.bill_dt},#{input.sply_amt},#{input.vat_amt},'DRAFT',#{input.txinv_no},#{input.txinv_dt}, 'Y',#{original.bill_id},#{input.rcpt_plan_dt},#{input.reason},#{actor}) RETURNING bill_id

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,n.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym,d.mm_qty, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty,d.ovtm_tm_qty, d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=COALESCE(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT COALESCE(h.rsn_desc,h.data_chg_ty_cd) AS description,h.chg_at AS changed_at, h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text) ORDER BY h.chg_at,h.data_chg_hist_id
mapper.sql: p.prj_id AS project_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, p.stlm_mthd_cd AS settlement,p.use_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT s.bill_stg_id AS stage_id,s.prj_id AS project_id,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.bill_stg_id=#{id}

SELECT s.bill_stg_id AS stage_id,s.prj_id AS project_id,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.bill_plan_dt)=#{year} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL') ORDER BY s.bill_stg_id

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, n.dev_nm AS display_name,n.mng_no AS management_number,a.asgn_se_cd AS kind,a.bgn_dt, m.mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt AS price,t.work_day_qty AS days,t.rglr_tm_qty AS hours, t.ovtm_tm_qty AS overtime,t.mth_work_day_qty AS denominator,p.stlm_mthd_cd AS settlement FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=COALESCE(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= GREATEST(CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date),a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date)+INTERVAL '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date) ORDER BY a.asgn_id
SELECT o.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std o WHERE o.oprt_std_id='VAT_RATE' AND o.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY o.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('MO','DP') AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date)+INTERVAL '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= CAST(#{month} || '-01' AS date)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM')) ORDER BY p.prj_id

SELECT b.bsn_part_nm AS sales_part,b.hq_yn FROM prj.prj_part_hist h LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=h.bsn_part_id WHERE h.prj_id=#{projectId} AND h.aply_bgn_ym <=#{month} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END
mapper.select: SELECT AS month,SUM(b.sply_amt)::bigint AS confirmed_supply_amt FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND left(,4)=CAST(#{year} AS text) GROUP BY ORDER BY month

SELECT r.rcpt_dt,SUM(r.rcpt_amt)::bigint AS rcpt_amt FROM bill.rcpt r JOIN bill.bill b ON b.bill_id=r.bill_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.rcpt_dt)=#{year} GROUP BY r.rcpt_dt ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.sply_amt),0)::bigint FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.bill_plan_dt)=#{year} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.orgnl_bill_id IS NULL AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL')
